new_news.headline: May 2026 Business Report – Q1 2026 Solid Waste Sector Highlights
new_news.summary: Waste360 Business Report covering Q1 2026 results from major publicly traded solid waste companies, including pricing, volumes, fuel costs, and commodity price trends. Includes discussion of RNG development and solid waste margin expansion.

new_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Q1 2026 Earnings: Record Renewable Diesel Margins and Investor Day Outlook
new_news.summary: In early May 2026, Darling reported first-quarter 2026 results showing revenue of US$1.55 billion and net income of US$134.31 million, emphasizing the growing contribution of Diamond Green Diesel and projected US$4–6 billion of cash generation from 2027 to 2030.

new_news.headline: Wärtsilä Unveils Innovative Wastewater Management Solution for Cruise Ships and Vessels
new_news.summary: Wärtsilä Water & Waste introduced a new Grease Trap – GM Series for maritime wastewater management, designed to separate fats, oils, and grease from galley wastewater. The modular system is available as of May 2026 and works for both newbuild and retrofit vessel projects across multiple sizes.

new_news.headline: Clean Harbors Reports Q1 2026 Earnings: Beats EPS, Misses Revenue
new_news.summary: Clean Harbors reported Q1 2026 EPS of $1.19 beating the $1.15 estimate, but revenue of $1.46 billion missed the $1.47 billion forecast. The company raised full-year adjusted EBITDA guidance to $1.24-$1.30 billion, driven by stronger Environmental Services segment performance and PFAS-related demand growth.

new_news.headline: Clean Harbors Q1 2026 Earnings Call Highlights
new_news.summary: Clean Harbors' Environmental Services segment achieved its 16th consecutive quarter of year-over-year margin improvement. PFAS-related revenue exceeded $120 million in 2025 with 25-35% growth expected in 2026. Safety-Kleen Sustainable Solutions benefited from higher base oil pricing with 17% EBITDA growth.

new_news.headline: GFL Environmental Q1 2026 Earnings Call: Record First-Quarter Profitability
new_news.summary: GFL Environmental reported record first-quarter 2026 profitability with adjusted EBITDA margin expanding 180 basis points to 29.1%. The company completed eight acquisitions year-to-date and announced a proposed acquisition of Secure Waste Infrastructure to strengthen operations in Western Canada.
